lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Primary nodes form a grid-like distribution with approximately 3 to 4 distinct spots per vertical column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal linear features to form a rectangular lattice; primary high-intensity blobs are positioned at the approximate center of these grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the upper edge and defined shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, elongated silhouettes consistent with commensal fish attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base.
